title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am from India & presently working in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I follow the Hanafi maslak. Sometimes due to work related travel I mis the jamat of Zohar salah. But I try to reach the masjid at the earliest to perform my Zohar salah. But sometime it happens that when I reach the masjid I find that Asar Jamat (as per Hambali timing) has started. But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. But this happens only sometimes may be once in 3-4 months. 3561 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49812 Country: India Title: DUA Question: Asking dua with imam is allowed or not. Is there any hadith? Answer ID: 49812 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 362/284/B=01/1435) The acceptance of dua after fardh salah and at the time of tahajjud is proved from sahih hadith. So we should supplicate after fardh salah whether we are behind imam or alone. In each case we will follow the hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
